requirements.quote: The screen shows, from one `OutcomeProposal`: what happened (editable text), adjournment reason, next date (proposed, with source anchor), stage after, directions as obligation proposals and tasks, each with a Provenance Chip to the transcript span or order line.

Confirm is disabled until the next date is explicitly confirmed, set to 'No next date / disposed', or marked 'To be notified'; the date field requires a human action even when proposed with high confidence.
A next date that is absent from every anchored source is rejected by the validator with a visible reason; it can only be entered manually.

When the proposed date differs from an existing confirmed canonical date, a conflict card shows both sources side by side and the existing date stays unchanged until the lawyer picks one; the choice is logged.

`confirmOutcome` runs in one transaction: updates hearing outcome, sets the canonical next date (single canonical per proceeding), creates confirmed obligations and tasks with provenance, writes `audit_event`, and is all-or-nothing on failure.
Each obligation proposal can be confirmed, edited (description, due date, owner) or dismissed; a dismissed item records a reason or 'not applicable'; none are silently created.
Manual entry works with no voice note or proposals (L0); a hearing with only a typed note produces the same confirmation path.
The transcript drawer shows the transcript with highlighted source spans and the original language (EN, TA, KN) without translation claims.
Time-to-confirm benchmark: with a 3-obligation seeded proposal the happy path takes at most 6 keyboard actions or 8 taps, asserted by an e2e step counter.
requirements.evidence: e2e/product/hearing-outcome.spec.ts step counter, run by the CI Playwright e2e job (ship PRs and nightly)

requirements.quote: All states handled: no proposal yet ('Processing your note'), low-confidence ('Needs you' with unanchored fields blank), error with retry, offline (confirm queues locally and is applied through the proposal flow on sync, never auto-overwriting), permission denied for viewer and clerk-without-rights.
Delegated appearances: a junior who appeared 'for' the lawyer can submit an outcome that notifies the owner; the owner's view updates live.
p95 server action < 300 ms for `confirmOutcomeAction` on seeded data.
requirements.evidence: CI e2e/api job timing assertion on seeded data (not run locally)

decisions.choice: Link a hearing to its proposals by proceeding + heldOn + payload hearingDate (no hearing_id on proposal) and do not enable the `hearing_outcome` handler; `confirmOutcome` writes directly and marks the matched proposals applied/dismissed.
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/schema/automation.ts:49 has no hearing column and packages/core/src/automation/handlers/disabled.ts:23 keeps the handler off; avoids a migration (issue: no new tables).

decisions.choice: Set and resolve the canonical next date only through matter-graph `confirmNextDate`/`chooseNextDateSource`, imported via the matter-graph index.
decisions.justification: packages/core/src/matter-graph/next-date.ts:1-12 (sole writer rule) and CLAUDE.md domain-import rule.

decisions.choice: i18n files go in packages/i18n/src/messages/<locale>/outcome.json, not the issue's packages/i18n/messages path.
decisions.justification: packages/i18n/src/messages/en/ holds the existing namespaces; catalog.ts NAMESPACES.
